propositions: Recursive conftest glob pattern `tests/**/conftest.py` in global_support causes all seven mutation shards to be selected for any nested conftest change, regardless of whether pytest loads that conftest for the shard's tests.

Runtime tracing shows pytest loads exactly six conftests (root plus five ancestors) for configured shard tests, never loading unrelated sibling fixture trees like `tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py`.
Across 97 recent Verify runs, seven proven over-trigger candidates consumed 322.6 runner-minutes without increasing coverage.

Per-shard conftest assignment—keeping only `tests/conftest.py` globally and mapping each non-root conftest to shards whose configured tests load it—enables dependency-accurate affected-test selection matching pytest's upward-only conftest scope.

A derived-ancestry contract expands configured shard test paths, computes their ancestor conftests, and asserts the per-shard manifest support closure matches exactly, failing closed on missing dependencies or stale entries.
Unrelated nested conftest changes select zero shards after fix; each declared ancestor conftest change selects exactly its dependent shards; all 374 configured tests pass with unchanged results.
